acceptance: No production-unreachable helper remains in the Doris load path.
Doris unit and integration tests pass.
description:
After #3949 (Doris Stream Load without the per-line rewrite), `_empty_fields_to_null` in benchbox/platforms/doris.py has no production caller but stays because a test outside that batch's scope imports it. The `requests`-missing executemany fallback also stays because an integration test asserts it. Both are dead weight on the load path.

Change. Remove `_empty_fields_to_null` and update its test. Decide whether the requests-missing fallback is still a supported configuration (requests is part of the doris extra?); if not, remove it and its test.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
